description: What each of the ten Celtic Cross tarot spread positions asks, from the heart of the matter to the outcome, with practical reading tips.
lede: Each of the ten Celtic Cross positions asks a different question. This guide goes through them in order, with a tip for each.

numbered.alt: The Celtic Cross tarot layout with ten numbered cards: a cross of six cards beside a vertical staff of four. Beside it is a legend listing the ten positions: 1 Heart of the matter, 2 Crossing, 3 Foundation, 4 Recent past, 5 Crown, 6 Near future, 7 You, 8 Surroundings, 9 Hopes and fears, 10 Outcome.
numbered.caption: Use the legend to match each numbered card to its position as you work through the spread.
